name: Republic of Poland

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 306,070 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 36,435,861. Range allows for 2026 drift and census revisions.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted: 173,000 active (Territorial Defence Force mostly outside this count). CIA Factbook 2025: ~235,000 active incl. professional territorials (high). Mid ~200,000 between the two; target 300,000 by 2035.

trainedReserves.note: IISS as quoted: 37,500 reserves. High is an educated allowance for former conscripts/voluntary basic service graduates callable within 30 days.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 200,000 minus infantry P roles (38,000). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Poland 1939 (~1.3 million mobilized from ~35 million, ~4%, partial and interrupted) raised for a frontline state with renewed voluntary service, training law of 2025 and high public support.

count.note: Educated guess. Mechanized infantry of 4-5 divisions (Rosomak/BWP-1/Borsuk battalions x ~500). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Polish_Land_Forces)

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.5 (era-typical) (slightly above): Mix of modern Rosomak/Borsuk and Soviet BWP-1.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly below): Professional, rapidly expanding.

count.note: Educated guess. Airmobile/air-assault brigades, mountain brigade, Territorial Defence Force full-time cadre (~20,000 rotating). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polish_Armed_Forces)

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.5 (era-typical) (slightly above): Modern light kit, Piorun MANPADS, Javelin/Spike.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly below): Mix of professionals and territorials.

commandQuality.note: Rubric commandQuality 0.75 (trained staff system, proven commanders) (slightly below): Competent NATO-integrated staff, expanding fast; no recent large-unit combat command.

cohesion.note: Rubric cohesion 0.75 (professional with strong unit identity) (slightly below): National army with strong historical identity, professionalised.

morale.note: Rubric morale 0.75 (motivated, recent victories) (slightly below): Motivated: Russian threat broadly perceived, very high public support for defence.

weapons.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: HIMARS/Chunmoo, Piorun, JASSM-ER, loitering munitions (Warmate).

armor.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: K2/Abrams SEPv3 composite armour, no APS.

ships.note: Between anchor 8 and 9: Small old navy; Miecznik frigates coming.

fortification.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: East Shield fortification line, Patriot/CAMM GBAD.

logistics.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Rail-heavy logistics, NATO hub (Rzeszow).

communications.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: NATO Link 16, national C2 modernising.

isr.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: TB2/MQ-9, Aerostat (Barbara) radars.

air.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: F-35A arriving, F-16 Block 52+.

cyber.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Cyberspace Defence Forces component.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 1,368,645,104,598 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 36,435,861 = 37,563. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 1,709,737,794,625 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 1,368,645,104,598 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 4.50% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 3.75% in 2024, 2.22% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 25.8% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Recomputed 2026-10-29 under the definition: 0.25 -> 0.94. Formula: surplus = 1 - a/s, a = farm population share of consumers (proxy: agricultural employment share, World Bank SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, ILO modelled, https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/POL/indicator/SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS), s = domestic production / consumption (calorie self-sufficiency). a = 6.22% (2025). s from FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheets (https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/FoodBalanceSheets_E_All_Data.zip): production / domestic supply summed over all FBS items, each weighted by kcal per tonne (world median of food kcal / food tonnes per item); feed, processing and non-food uses stay in domestic supply. s = 1.13 (mean 2021-2023, range 1.09-1.17). Mid 1 - 0.062/1.13 = 0.94. Low: a x 1.3 (farm households larger than the employed count), s 1.09 = 0.93. High: s 1.17 = 0.95. Net exporter: production is about 113% of domestic calorie supply. Earlier net-trade reading: Educated guess. Large net exporter of grain, meat and dairy.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 17,645,223 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 5.681% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 200,488. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

artillery.note: Educated guess. HSW Stalowa Wola Krab/Borsuk and Chunmoo/K9PL localisation. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Polish_Land_Forces)

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. Rosomak (Siemianowice) and Borsuk lines.

armor.note: Educated guess. K2PL local production starting 2026.

drones.note: Educated guess. WB Group FlyEye/Gladius; Group 2+ share only.

helicopters.note: Educated guess. PZL Swidnik AW149, PZL Mielec Black Hawk.

roadKm.note: As quoted: 429,800 km of which 293,800 paved (2026 row).

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 18,620 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

merchantTonnage.note: Educated guess. Not in the UNCTAD table quoted on the merchant navy list; CIA Factbook lists 152 Polish-flag vessels (2023), mostly small "other". Polish-owned bulk fleet (PZM) sails under foreign flags. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_merchant_navy_capacity_by_country)

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: familiar terrain, East Shield fortifications, strong population support; North European Plain offers little natural obstacle.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:POL. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Polish Land Forces equipment list (dated Oct 2025), Polish Air Force and Navy articles; drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Poland is mid-rearmament: K2, K9, Chunmoo, Abrams, Apache and F-35 deliveries continue through 2030, so 2026 counts change fast.
